dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple light-intensity 'O' and 'C' shaped perimeters exhibit irregular, crenulated boundaries; geometry transitions from a dark-pixel background to high-contrast light-pixel perimeters surrounding darker cores on the mid-lateral torso.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of solid, high-intensity light pixel clusters lacking internal gradients concentrated along the ventral-lateral margin and near the base of the pectoral flipper.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent lateral annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle, while smaller high-intensity blobs along the lower flank form a roughly linear geometric series.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense, fine-grain light-intensity speckling present on the cranial-dorsal surface and around the muzzle, contrasting with the uniform dark mask of the facial region.
